summary.text: Leader of the Danaans whom Hector slew in his rampage — distinct from Opheltius whom Euryalus laid low in the battle of *Iliad* 6.

story.text: Hector, when Zeus vouchsafed him glory, slew among the leaders of the Danaans Opheltius together with Asaeus, Autonous, Opites, Dolops son of Clytius, Agelaus, Aesymnus, Orus, and Hipponous, and thereafter fell upon the multitude like the West Wind driving the clouds of the South Wind.
